title: 1310 Oak Street (House), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: This single family residence is a contributing building in the Columbus Near East Side Historic District, a predominately residential area containing those architectural styles favored by the upper middle class between 1880 and 1930. Oak Street was a major thoroughfare in the Near East Side and contains a mixture of residential and commercial buildings.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
